reading.body:
Luma AI, founded in 2021 and based in Redwood City, California, operates a video generation platform using models called Ray and Uni, with significant legal exposure concentrated in its home state.

The company positions itself in the creative AI layer, which sits downstream of the compute infrastructure required to run large generative models. Video generation demands substantially more compute per inference than text or image generation, making it sensitive to the availability of both processing power and the electricity to run it. Luma's focus on "end-to-end workflows" and brand-specific customization suggests the company is building toward higher-friction, more resource-intensive use cases rather than commodity generation.

The 181 California legal cases recorded against Luma likely reflect the jurisdictional reality of operating a generative AI company in that state, but the data does not specify the nature, stage, or outcome of these cases. This number alone does not indicate whether legal exposure is typical for a company of this size and category, or whether it signals particular vulnerability. The absence of SEC filing data means the company remains private or very young to public markets, which limits visibility into financial health, capital intensity, and revenue exposure to compute costs. This data covers what Luma does and where it operates, not what it requires to operate or whether it can sustain those requirements.

profile_text.body:
Luma AI is a creative AI platform for video generation and image creation, headquartered in Redwood City, California. The company describes itself as powered by video generation models called Ray and Uni, along with creative agents that handle end-to-end workflows. According to its website, Luma AI is trusted by leading agencies and brands, and it operates as a lean team focused on building creative intelligence tools.

The company's product lineup centers on its Luma AI platform for 3D and video generation. The site highlights Uni-1 as a model-level brand intelligence system that understands brand identity and carries style references, character references, and visual grounding into generated assets. Luma AI has also partnered with Wonder Project and launched innovative production services that combine generative AI with traditional filmmaking.

Founded in 2021, Luma AI operates in a jurisdiction with significant law exposure, with 208 related legal matters recorded in California.
